scripts.dev:explorer: npm run build:electron:main && node scripts/electron-dev-entry.mjs explorer
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:electron:main && node scripts/electron-dev-entry.mjs client
scripts.build:electron:main: node scripts/clean-electron-build.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.electron-build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.electron-preload-build.json && node scripts/copy-electron-runtime.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:electron:main && npm run build:host && electron-forge package
scripts.make: npm run build && npm run build:electron:main && npm run build:host && electron-forge make
scripts.check: svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && npm run check:trace && npm run check:tests && npm run check:electron
scripts.lint: npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:dead && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:ts: eslint src scripts electron vite.config.ts eslint.config.mjs forge.config.cjs
scripts.dev:explorer:release: npm run build:electron:main && node scripts/electron-dev-entry.mjs explorer --release
scripts.dev:client:release: npm run build:electron:main && node scripts/electron-dev-entry.mjs client --release
